name: Grid Balance · Supply Stack

Sources table reorders with a WAAPI FLIP. Set --dbt-grid-h to 100dvh to fill an app shell.

name: Home Energy Flow

Set --dbt-home-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Line OEE · Six Big Losses

Card reorders use a WAAPI FLIP. Set --dbt-oee-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: HVAC Zones · Floor Plan

Set --dbt-hvac-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: EV Charging Network
note: Fair-share load management, drawn: each stall's allocation is a clip-path slice of one budget bar whose edges are registered @property numbers, so dragging a site's grid cap re-flows every slice and hatches the power held back; state-of-charge bars and their percentages animate through @property number and integer (a CSS counter). The whole day is replayed from one 30-second charging model, so sessions, KPIs and charts agree. Set --dbt-charge-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Water Network · ISA-101 HMI
note: A high-performance HMI in the ISA-101 idiom: grey by design, with colour reserved for alarms and coded again by shape and number; every reading carries an analog range indicator, flow dashes advance with measured flow in a rAF loop that pauses off screen, and alarms follow ISA-18.2 states with acknowledge re-filing cards by WAAPI FLIP. Trend, night-flow leakage and alarm text all read one hydraulic model. Set --dbt-water-h to 100dvh in an app.
